ams2:Chevrolet Omega Stock Car 1999.notes: 1999 Stock Car Omega: the Opala 4.1 six at 338 hp (wiki) in a tube-frame silhouette, 5-speed dogleg H-pattern, 1080 kg. Nothing electronic (wiki).

ams2:Chevrolet Cruze Stock Car 2019.name: Chevrolet Cruze Stock Car 2019
ams2:Chevrolet Cruze Stock Car 2019.notes: Stock Car Brasil 2019: Mast JLR 5.7 cross-plane V8 at 473 hp (wiki), 6-speed sequential on paddles, 1340 kg, push-to-pass. Big V8 lope and heavy pulses (16 Hz), a straight-cut sequential (whine 0.8). The wiki infobox writes Chevrolet Cruze (2019); confirm the string. No TC, no ABS (wiki).

ams2:Chevrolet Cruze Stock Car 2020.name: Chevrolet Cruze Stock Car 2020
ams2:Chevrolet Cruze Stock Car 2020.notes: Stock Car Brasil 2020 Cruze: same V8 and sequential as 2019. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Toyota Corolla Stock Car 2020.name: Toyota Corolla Stock Car 2020
ams2:Toyota Corolla Stock Car 2020.notes: Stock Car Brasil 2020 Corolla: the series' spec V8 and sequential under a Toyota shell. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Chevrolet Cruze Stock Car 2021.name: Chevrolet Cruze Stock Car 2021
ams2:Chevrolet Cruze Stock Car 2021.notes: Stock Car Brasil 2021 Cruze: spec V8 and sequential. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Toyota Corolla Stock Car 2021.name: Toyota Corolla Stock Car 2021
ams2:Toyota Corolla Stock Car 2021.notes: Stock Car Brasil 2021 Corolla: spec V8 and sequential. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Chevrolet Cruze Stock Car 2022.name: Chevrolet Cruze Stock Car 2022
ams2:Chevrolet Cruze Stock Car 2022.notes: Stock Car Pro Series 2022 Cruze: spec V8 and sequential. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Toyota Corolla Stock Car 2022.name: Toyota Corolla Stock Car 2022
ams2:Toyota Corolla Stock Car 2022.notes: Stock Car Pro Series 2022 Corolla: spec V8 and sequential. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Chevrolet Cruze Stock Car 2023.name: Chevrolet Cruze Stock Car 2023
ams2:Chevrolet Cruze Stock Car 2023.notes: Stock Car Pro Series 2023: the wiki lists a 6.8 litre V8 at 353 kW for this season (the series moved to a larger-displacement spec engine), 6-speed sequential paddles, 1370 kg, push-to-pass. Heavier pulses still (carrier 15 Hz). Wiki infobox name Chevrolet Cruze (2023): confirm. No TC, no ABS (wiki).

ams2:Toyota Corolla Stock Car 2023.name: Toyota Corolla Stock Car 2023
ams2:Toyota Corolla Stock Car 2023.notes: Stock Car Pro Series 2023 Corolla: the 2023 spec V8. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Chevrolet Cruze Stock Car 2024.name: Chevrolet Cruze Stock Car 2024
ams2:Chevrolet Cruze Stock Car 2024.notes: Stock Car Pro Series 2024 Cruze: the 2023 spec V8 carried over. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Toyota Corolla Stock Car 2024.name: Toyota Corolla Stock Car 2024
ams2:Toyota Corolla Stock Car 2024.notes: Stock Car Pro Series 2024 Corolla: the 2023 spec V8 carried over. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Stock USA Gen1.name: Stock USA Gen1
ams2:Stock USA Gen1.notes: NASCAR-style Gen 1 (1990s body): 358 cubic inch pushrod V8 on a carburettor, about 750 hp, 9000 rpm, 4-speed H-pattern with straight-cut gears (whine 0.5), solid rear axle with lots of lash. The lumpiest big V8 in the game (rock 0.9, thump 1.0 at 15 Hz). No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Stock USA Gen2.name: Stock USA Gen2
ams2:Stock USA Gen2.notes: NASCAR-style Gen 2 (2000s body): same 358 V8 with fuel injection from 2012 on, 4-speed H-pattern. Values as Gen1. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Stock USA Gen3.name: Stock USA Gen3
ams2:Stock USA Gen3.notes: NASCAR Next Gen style: 5.86 litre V8 at 677 hp (wiki, the restricted figure), 5-speed sequential, independent rear, 1542 kg. Sequential straight-cut box (whine 0.7). No TC, no ABS (wiki).

ams2:Stock USA Gen3 LM.name: Stock USA Gen3 LM
ams2:Stock USA Gen3 LM.notes: The Garage 56 Le Mans version of the Next Gen car: same V8 and sequential, more power, endurance lights. Values as Gen3. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Super V8 (Gen2 ZB).name: Super V8 (Gen2 ZB)
ams2:Super V8 (Gen2 ZB).notes: Australian Supercars Gen2 ZB style: 5.0 V8 at 631 hp (wiki), 7500 rpm, 6-speed sequential stick, 1395 kg. Cross-plane lope with a famous crackling overrun (pops 0.8), straight-cut Albins sequential (whine 0.8). Roster name Super V8 (Gen2 ZB); the wiki page is Super V8: confirm the string. No TC, no ABS (wiki).

ams2:Metalmoro AJR Judd.name: Metalmoro AJR Judd
ams2:Metalmoro AJR Judd.notes: Brazilian P1 prototype with the Judd 4.2 V10 at 556 hp (wiki), 6-speed sequential paddles, 950 kg: a screaming NA V10 in a 950 kg car, straight-cut sequential. No TC, no ABS (wiki).

ams2:Metalmoro AJR Nissan.name: Metalmoro AJR Nissan
ams2:Metalmoro AJR Nissan.notes: AJR with the Nissan 3.5 V6 turbo at 560 hp (wiki), 6-speed sequential, 960 kg: turbo V6 with a big dump on lift. No TC, no ABS (wiki).

ams2:Metalmoro AJR Honda.name: Metalmoro AJR Honda
ams2:Metalmoro AJR Honda.notes: AJR with the Honda 2.4 four turbo at 579 hp (wiki), 6-speed sequential paddles, 935 kg: a big turbo four, more shake and a bigger dump. TC yes, ABS yes (wiki).

ams2:Metalmoro AJR Chevrolet.name: Metalmoro AJR Chevrolet
ams2:Metalmoro AJR Chevrolet.notes: AJR with the 6.2 LS V8 at 594 hp (wiki), 6-speed sequential paddles, 960 kg: cross-plane rumble and heavy pulses. TC yes, ABS yes (wiki).

ams2:Metalmoro AJR Gen2 Chevrolet.name: Metalmoro AJR Gen2 Chevrolet
ams2:Metalmoro AJR Gen2 Chevrolet.notes: The Gen2 AJR chassis with the 6.2 LS V8. Values as the Gen1 Chevrolet. TC and ABS on.

ams2:Metalmoro AJR Gen2 Honda.name: Metalmoro AJR Gen2 Honda
ams2:Metalmoro AJR Gen2 Honda.notes: The Gen2 AJR with the Honda 2.4 turbo four. Values as the Gen1 Honda. TC and ABS on.

ams2:Metalmoro AJR Gen2 Nissan.name: Metalmoro AJR Gen2 Nissan
ams2:Metalmoro AJR Gen2 Nissan.notes: The Gen2 AJR with the Nissan 3.5 V6 turbo; the Gen2 cars carry the class electronics, so TC and ABS on (the Gen1 Nissan has neither per the wiki).

ams2:Ginetta G58.name: Ginetta G58
ams2:Ginetta G58.notes: Ginetta G58 prototype with the 6.2 LS V8 at 564 hp (wiki), 6-speed sequential, 1020 kg. TC yes, ABS yes (wiki).

ams2:Ginetta G58 Gen2.name: Ginetta G58 Gen2
ams2:Ginetta G58 Gen2.notes: The updated G58 for P1 Gen 2: same V8 and sequential. TC and ABS on.

ams2:Ligier JS P320.name: Ligier JS P320
ams2:Ligier JS P320.notes: LMP3 Gen 2: Nissan VK56 5.6 V8 at 455 hp, 6-speed sequential paddles. A production-based cross-plane V8 with a race exhaust. LMP3 allows traction control, no ABS.

ams2:Sigma P1 G5.name: Sigma P1 G5
ams2:Sigma P1 G5.notes: Sigma P1 G5: 6.9 litre NA V8 at 573 hp (wiki), 6-speed sequential paddles, 1050 kg. The biggest-displacement V8 here, slow heavy pulses. TC yes, ABS yes (wiki).

ams2:Sigma P1.name: Sigma P1
ams2:Sigma P1.notes: P2-class Sigma P1: 4.2 V8 turbo at 501 hp (wiki), 6-speed sequential, 1170 kg. Turbo V8 dump on lift. TC yes, ABS yes (wiki).

ams2:Metalmoro MRX Duratec P2.name: Metalmoro MRX Duratec P2
ams2:Metalmoro MRX Duratec P2.notes: MRX with the Duratec 2.0 turbo at 372 hp (wiki), 6-speed sequential, 800 kg. TC yes, ABS no (wiki).

ams2:Metalmoro MRX Honda P3.name: Metalmoro MRX Honda P3
ams2:Metalmoro MRX Honda P3.notes: MRX with the Honda K20 2.0 NA at 303 hp (wiki), 6-speed sequential stick, 740 kg: a high-revving NA four (9000 rpm) with overrun crackle. No TC, no ABS (wiki).

ams2:Metalmoro MRX Duratec P3.name: Metalmoro MRX Duratec P3
ams2:Metalmoro MRX Duratec P3.notes: MRX with the NA Duratec 2.0 in P3 trim (about 280 hp), 6-speed sequential. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Metalmoro MRX Duratec P4.name: Metalmoro MRX Duratec P4
ams2:Metalmoro MRX Duratec P4.notes: MRX with the Duratec 2.0 in P4 trim (about 230 hp), 6-speed sequential. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Roco 001.name: Roco 001
ams2:Roco 001.notes: Roco 001 P3 prototype: 1.5 four at 283 hp (wiki) in 550 kg, which means a very high-revving motorcycle-derived engine, 6-speed sequential: buzz, no inertia, high cut. No TC, no ABS (wiki).

ams2:MCR S2000.name: MCR S2000
ams2:MCR S2000.notes: MCR S2000 P4 prototype: 2.0 NA four at 217 hp (wiki), 5-speed sequential, 525 kg. No TC, no ABS (wiki).

ams2:Puma P052.name: Puma P052
ams2:Puma P052.notes: GT5-class Puma P052: mid-engined 1.6 turbo four at 163 hp (wiki), 5-speed H-pattern, 940 kg. No TC, no ABS (wiki).

ams2:Ginetta G40.name: Ginetta G40
ams2:Ginetta G40.notes: GT5-class Ginetta G40: Ford 1.8 Zetec four at about 175 hp, 5-speed sequential dog box (whine 0.7), 800 kg. The G40 Cup is a separate entry (wiki infobox name Ginetta G40 Cup). No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Ginetta G40 Cup.name: Ginetta G40 Cup
ams2:Ginetta G40 Cup.notes: Ginetta Junior / G40 Cup car: 1.8 Ford Zetec at 142 hp (wiki), 5-speed H-pattern manual (synchro shape, clutch 1.0), 925 kg. The novice car: soft, lots of lug. No TC, no ABS (wiki).

ams2:Ginetta G55 Supercup.name: Ginetta G55 Supercup
ams2:Ginetta G55 Supercup.notes: G55 Supercup: Ford 3.7 Cyclone V6 at 370 hp (wiki), 6-speed sequential paddles, 1195 kg. Supercup runs without aids: no TC, no ABS (wiki).

ams2:Ginetta G55 GT4.name: Ginetta G55 GT4
ams2:Ginetta G55 GT4.notes: G55 in GT4 trim: the 3.7 V6 at about 350 hp with the GT4 electronics. ABS and TC on.

ams2:Ginetta G55 GT3.name: Ginetta G55 GT3
ams2:Ginetta G55 GT3.notes: G55 GT3: 4.3 V8 (Ford-based) at about 440 hp, 6-speed sequential dog box. GT3-style: ABS and TC on.

ams2:Ultima GTR Race.name: Ultima GTR Race
ams2:Ultima GTR Race.notes: GT Open Ultima GTR race car: 6.2 LS V8 around 560 hp in a 1000 kg kit-car chassis, sequential dog box. GT Open spec without aids: no TC, no ABS.

ams2:Ligier JS2 R.name: Ligier JS2 R
ams2:Ligier JS2 R.notes: Ligier European Series JS2 R: Ford 3.7 V6 at 330 hp, 6-speed sequential paddles. The JS2 R runs ABS and TC.

ams2:Ligier JS P4.name: Ligier JS P4
ams2:Ligier JS P4.notes: Ligier JS P4 prototype: the same 3.7 V6 at about 330 hp, 6-speed sequential. TC on, no ABS (the P4 class runs without it).

ams2:Ligier JS P217.name: Ligier JS P217
ams2:Ligier JS P217.notes: LMP2 Gen 2: Gibson GK428 4.2 V8 at 600 hp, 8500 rpm, Xtrac 6-speed sequential paddles. A flat-plane race V8 with a loud overrun. LMP2 runs traction control, no ABS.

ams2:Oreca 07.name: Oreca 07
ams2:Oreca 07.notes: LMP2 Gen 2 Oreca 07: the same Gibson V8 and Xtrac box. TC on, no ABS.

ams2:Cadillac DPi-V.R.name: Cadillac DPi-V.R
ams2:Cadillac DPi-V.R.notes: IMSA DPi: ECR 5.5 cross-plane V8 at about 600 hp, 7600 rpm, Xtrac 6-speed sequential paddles. The big V8 rumble in a prototype, loud overrun. DPi: TC on, no ABS.

ams2:Kartcross.name: Kartcross
ams2:Kartcross.notes: Kartcross buggy: a 1.0 litre motorcycle inline-four (about 150 hp, 13000 rpm) with the bike's 6-speed sequential dog box and a chain drive, in a 400 kg tube frame: all buzz, no inertia, lots of shunt. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Audi R8 LMS GT3.name: Audi R8 LMS GT3
ams2:Audi R8 LMS GT3.notes: First-generation R8 LMS GT3 (2015 car): 5.2 NA V10 about 560 hp, X-trac six-speed sequential dog box (whine 0.8), loud overrun. Same values as the AC R8 LMS. GT3: ABS and TC on.

ams2:BMW M6 GT3.name: BMW M6 GT3
ams2:BMW M6 GT3.notes: S63 4.4 twin-turbo cross-plane V8 at about 580 hp: a rumbling turbo V8 with a big dump on lift (1.6) and a crackle, torque into the lash (shunt 0.75). Ricardo six-speed sequential. GT3: ABS and TC on.

ams2:McLaren 720S.name: McLaren 720S
ams2:McLaren 720S.notes: The 720S GT3 (roster name just McLaren 720S): M840T 4.0 twin-turbo flat-plane V8 at about 520 hp, Ricardo six-speed sequential. Flat-plane buzz, turbo flutter and dump. GT3: ABS and TC on.

ams2:Mercedes-AMG GT3.name: Mercedes-AMG GT3
ams2:Mercedes-AMG GT3.notes: M159 6.2 NA cross-plane V8, side exhausts, the loudest overrun bark in GT3 (pops 0.8), lumpy race idle. Hewland six-speed sequential. Same values as the AC AMG GT3. GT3: ABS and TC on.

ams2:Nissan GT-R Nismo GT3.name: Nissan GT-R Nismo GT3
ams2:Nissan GT-R Nismo GT3.notes: VR38DETT 3.8 twin-turbo V6 at about 550 hp, rear-drive, Ricardo sequential. Same values as the AC GT-R GT3. GT3: ABS and TC on.

ams2:Porsche 911 GT3 R.name: Porsche 911 GT3 R
ams2:Porsche 911 GT3 R.notes: 991.2 GT3 R: 4.0 NA flat-six at about 500 hp, 9000 rpm, six-speed sequential dog box (whine 0.9), race exhaust (pops 0.8). Same values as the AC GT3 R 2016. GT3: ABS and TC on.

ams2:Aston Martin Vantage GT3 EVO.name: Aston Martin Vantage GT3 EVO
ams2:Aston Martin Vantage GT3 EVO.notes: GT3 Gen 2 Vantage: the AMG-sourced 4.0 twin-turbo cross-plane V8 at about 535 hp, Xtrac six-speed sequential: turbo V8 rumble, dump on lift. GT3: ABS and TC on.

ams2:Audi R8 LMS GT3 evo II.name: Audi R8 LMS GT3 evo II
ams2:Audi R8 LMS GT3 evo II.notes: The 2022 evo II: same 5.2 V10 and sequential as the first-generation car. GT3: ABS and TC on.

ams2:BMW M4 GT3.name: BMW M4 GT3
ams2:BMW M4 GT3.notes: P58 3.0 twin-turbo inline-six at about 590 hp: a smooth six with two turbos that breathe hard on lift (1.6) and a cracking race exhaust. Xtrac six-speed sequential. GT3: ABS and TC on.

ams2:Chevrolet Corvette Z06 GT3.R.name: Chevrolet Corvette Z06 GT3.R
ams2:Chevrolet Corvette Z06 GT3.R.notes: LT6-based 5.5 flat-plane V8 at about 500 hp restricted, 8600 rpm: unlike every other Corvette here it is a flat-plane crank, so it screams rather than rumbles (buzz 0.95). Xtrac six-speed sequential. GT3: ABS and TC on.

ams2:Lamborghini Huracan GT3 EVO2.name: Lamborghini Huracan GT3 EVO2
ams2:Lamborghini Huracan GT3 EVO2.notes: EVO2 Huracán GT3: the 5.2 V10 and X-trac sequential, the Audi's twin. GT3: ABS and TC on.

ams2:McLaren 720S GT3 EVO.name: McLaren 720S GT3 EVO
ams2:McLaren 720S GT3 EVO.notes: The 2023 EVO: same M840T twin-turbo V8 and Ricardo sequential as the 720S GT3. GT3: ABS and TC on.

ams2:Mercedes-AMG GT3 EVO.name: Mercedes-AMG GT3 EVO
ams2:Mercedes-AMG GT3 EVO.notes: The 2020 EVO: same 6.2 V8 and Hewland box as the AMG GT3. GT3: ABS and TC on.

ams2:Porsche 992 GT3-R.name: Porsche 992 GT3-R
ams2:Porsche 992 GT3-R.notes: 992 GT3 R: the flat-six grown to 4.2 litres, about 565 hp, 9250 rpm, six-speed sequential (whine 0.9). GT3: ABS and TC on.

ams2:Alpine A110 GT4 EVO.name: Alpine A110 GT4 EVO
ams2:Alpine A110 GT4 EVO.notes: 1.8 turbo four at about 300 hp in a light mid-engined GT4, turbo whoosh on lift (1.5), six-speed sequential. GT4: ABS and TC on.

ams2:Aston Martin Vantage GT4 EVO.name: Aston Martin Vantage GT4 EVO
ams2:Aston Martin Vantage GT4 EVO.notes: The 4.0 twin-turbo AMG V8 in GT4 tune (about 450 hp), Xtrac sequential: turbo V8 rumble. GT4: ABS and TC on.

ams2:Audi R8 LMS GT4.name: Audi R8 LMS GT4
ams2:Audi R8 LMS GT4.notes: GT4 R8: the road car's 5.2 V10 at about 495 hp with the seven-speed S tronic DCT (synchro-shaped shifts). GT4: ABS and TC on.

ams2:BMW M4 GT4.name: BMW M4 GT4
ams2:BMW M4 GT4.notes: G82 M4 GT4: S58 3.0 twin-turbo six at about 550 hp with the ZF eight-speed automatic (synchro-shaped shifts). GT4: ABS and TC on.

ams2:Chevrolet Camaro GT4.R.name: Chevrolet Camaro GT4.R
ams2:Chevrolet Camaro GT4.R.notes: LT1 6.2 pushrod V8 at about 480 hp: the muscle-car lope in a GT4, Xtrac six-speed sequential. GT4: ABS and TC on.

ams2:McLaren 570S.name: McLaren 570S
ams2:McLaren 570S.notes: The 570S GT4 (roster name McLaren 570S): 3.8 twin-turbo flat-plane V8 restricted to about 450 hp, seven-speed DCT. GT4: ABS and TC on.

ams2:Mercedes-AMG GT4.name: Mercedes-AMG GT4
ams2:Mercedes-AMG GT4.notes: M178 4.0 twin-turbo V8 at about 480 hp with the AMG seven-speed DCT transaxle: turbo V8 rumble, DCT shifts. GT4: ABS and TC on.

ams2:Porsche Cayman GT4 Clubsport MR.name: Porsche Cayman GT4 Clubsport MR
ams2:Porsche Cayman GT4 Clubsport MR.notes: The 981 Clubsport MR: 3.8 flat-six at 385 hp with the PDK (synchro shape). Same values as the AC Clubsport. GT4: ABS and TC on.

ams2:Aston Martin Vantage GTE.name: Aston Martin Vantage GTE
ams2:Aston Martin Vantage GTE.notes: 2018 Vantage GTE: 4.0 twin-turbo V8 at about 500 hp, Xtrac six-speed sequential. Turbo V8 character. GTE: ABS and TC on.

ams2:BMW M8 GTE.name: BMW M8 GTE
ams2:BMW M8 GTE.notes: S63-based 4.0 twin-turbo V8 at about 500 hp, Xtrac sequential: the M6 GT3's engine family in the GTE car. GTE: ABS and TC on.

ams2:Chevrolet Corvette C8.R.name: Chevrolet Corvette C8.R
ams2:Chevrolet Corvette C8.R.notes: C8.R: the 5.5 flat-plane LT6 race engine, about 500 hp, 8500 rpm, Xtrac sequential: a screaming Corvette, unlike the C7.R's cross-plane rumble. GTE: ABS and TC on.

ams2:Porsche 911 RSR-19.name: Porsche 911 RSR-19
ams2:Porsche 911 RSR-19.notes: 2019 RSR: mid-mounted 4.2 flat-six at about 510 hp, 9250 rpm, side exhausts, six-speed sequential. GTE: ABS and TC on.

ams2:McLaren F1 GTR.name: McLaren F1 GTR
ams2:McLaren F1 GTR.notes: 1997 Longtail: BMW S70/2 6.1 V12 restricted to about 600 hp, 6-speed sequential dog box (the Longtail had the X-trac sequential). Same values as the AC F1 GTR. 1997 GT1: no ABS, no TC.

ams2:Mercedes-Benz CLK LM.name: Mercedes-Benz CLK LM
ams2:Mercedes-Benz CLK LM.notes: 1998 CLK LM: M119 5.0 cross-plane V8 (the GTR's V12 replaced for Le Mans) at about 600 hp, X-trac six-speed sequential. 1998 GT1: no ABS, no TC.

ams2:Nissan R390 GT1.name: Nissan R390 GT1
ams2:Nissan R390 GT1.notes: 1998 R390: VRH35L 3.5 twin-turbo V8 at about 650 hp, X-trac six-speed sequential. Two big turbos dumping on lift (1.7). 1998 GT1: no ABS, no TC.

ams2:Porsche 911 GT1-98.name: Porsche 911 GT1-98
ams2:Porsche 911 GT1-98.notes: Same car as the AC 911 GT1-98: 3.2 twin-turbo flat-six, six-speed sequential. Values copied. No ABS, no TC.

ams2:Aston Martin DBR9.name: Aston Martin DBR9
ams2:Aston Martin DBR9.notes: 2005 GT1: 6.0 V12 at about 600 hp restricted, 7000 rpm, Xtrac six-speed sequential, the howl of a big NA twelve. GT1 of 2005 allowed ABS and TC: both on.

ams2:Chevrolet Corvette C5-R.name: Chevrolet Corvette C5-R
ams2:Chevrolet Corvette C5-R.notes: C5-R: 7.0 pushrod cross-plane V8 at about 610 hp, 6500 rpm, Xtrac six-speed sequential: the heaviest pulses of the GT1 field (15 Hz), a huge overrun bark. 2005 GT1: ABS and TC on.

ams2:Dodge Viper GTS-R.name: Dodge Viper GTS-R
ams2:Dodge Viper GTS-R.notes: 8.0 pushrod V10 at about 650 hp and only 6000 rpm: a truck-derived ten with an odd-fire lumpiness (rock 0.8, thump 1.0 at 15 Hz). Six-speed sequential. 2005 GT1 spec: ABS and TC on.

ams2:Lamborghini Murcielago R-GT.name: Lamborghini Murcielago R-GT
ams2:Lamborghini Murcielago R-GT.notes: Reiter-built R-GT: 6.0 V12 at about 580 hp restricted, rear-drive, Holinger six-speed sequential. 2005 GT1: ABS and TC on.

ams2:Lister Storm GTM.name: Lister Storm GTM
ams2:Lister Storm GTM.notes: Storm GTM: 7.0 Jaguar V12 (the XJR-9's engine) at about 600 hp, front-mounted, six-speed sequential: a lazier, heavier V12 than the Italian ones. 2005 GT1: ABS and TC on.

ams2:Maserati MC12 GT1.name: Maserati MC12 GT1
ams2:Maserati MC12 GT1.notes: Same car as the AC MC12 GT1. Values copied. ABS and TC on.

ams2:Milano GT55.name: Milano GT55
ams2:Milano GT55.notes: Fictional GT1 (wiki: Ferrari 550 GT1 inspired): 6.0 V12 at 576 hp, 6-speed sequential, 1235 kg. Front-engined V12 howl. Wiki: no TC, no ABS, which is how the Prodrive 550 ran.

ams2:Saleen S7-R GT1.name: Saleen S7-R GT1
ams2:Saleen S7-R GT1.notes: S7-R: 7.0 Ford-based pushrod V8 at about 600 hp, mid-mounted, six-speed sequential: big-block rumble behind your head. 2005 GT1: ABS and TC on.

ams2:Milano GT36.name: Milano GT36
ams2:Milano GT36.notes: Fictional GT2 (wiki: Ferrari 360 GT based): 3.6 flat-plane V8 at 471 hp, 6-speed sequential, 1185 kg. Wiki: no TC, no ABS.

ams2:Panoz Esperante GTLM.name: Panoz Esperante GTLM
ams2:Panoz Esperante GTLM.notes: Esperante GTLM: front-mounted Ford 5.0 pushrod-derived V8 (Elan) at about 450 hp, six-speed sequential, the 2006 Le Mans GT2 winner. 2005 GT2 spec in the game: ABS and TC on.

ams2:Porsche 996 GT3 RSR.name: Porsche 996 GT3 RSR
ams2:Porsche 996 GT3 RSR.notes: 996 GT3 RSR: 3.6 flat-six at about 445 hp, 8250 rpm, six-speed sequential dog box. 2005 GT2: ABS and TC on.

ams2:Spyker C8 Spyder GT2-R.name: Spyker C8 Spyder GT2-R
ams2:Spyker C8 Spyder GT2-R.notes: C8 Spyder GT2-R: Audi 3.8 (4.2-derived) V8 at about 400 hp, mid-mounted, six-speed sequential. 2005 GT2: ABS and TC on.

ams2:TVR Tuscan T400R GT2.name: TVR Tuscan T400R GT2
ams2:TVR Tuscan T400R GT2.notes: T400R: TVR's own 4.0 Speed Six inline-six at about 400 hp, front-mounted, a rough-edged straight six with a loud exhaust, sequential box. 2005 GT2: ABS and TC on.

ams2:Chevrolet Corvette C3.R.name: Chevrolet Corvette C3.R
ams2:Chevrolet Corvette C3.R.notes: 1970s C3 race car: 7.0 big-block V8 on a Holley, about 600 hp, 6500 rpm, side pipes: the biggest lope and heaviest pulses in the game (14 Hz), 4-speed Muncie H-pattern with lots of lash. Nothing electronic.

ams2:Chevrolet Corvette C3.R Convertible.name: Chevrolet Corvette C3.R Convertible
ams2:Chevrolet Corvette C3.R Convertible.notes: The open C3.R: identical mechanicals. Nothing electronic.

ams2:Porsche 911 RSR.name: Porsche 911 RSR
ams2:Porsche 911 RSR.notes: The GT Classic 911 RSR 3.0, the same car as the AC Carrera RSR 3.0. Values copied. Nothing electronic.

ams2:BMW M3 E46 GTR.name: BMW M3 E46 GTR
ams2:BMW M3 E46 GTR.notes: 2004 E46 GTR: P60 4.0 V8 at about 450 hp, 8000 rpm, six-speed sequential (the ALMS/Nürburgring car). ABS and TC on.

ams2:Gillet Vertigo Streiff.name: Gillet Vertigo Streiff
ams2:Gillet Vertigo Streiff.notes: Belgian Vertigo Streiff: Maserati-derived 4.2 V8 at about 420 hp in a 900 kg carbon car, sequential box. GTR 2004 class: ABS and TC on.

ams2:Audi V8 quattro DTM.name: Audi V8 quattro DTM
ams2:Audi V8 quattro DTM.notes: 1990-92 DTM Audi V8: 3.6 V8 at about 460 hp, 9500 rpm, quattro, straight-cut 6-speed dog box, the heavy sedan that beat the M3s. The Audi ran ABS; no TC in those years.

ams2:BMW M3 Sport Evo GrA.name: BMW M3 Sport Evo GrA
ams2:BMW M3 Sport Evo GrA.notes: The 2.5 Sport Evolution Group A car, the same engine and box as the AC E30 DTM entry. Values copied. No ABS, no TC.

ams2:Mercedes-Benz 190E EVO 2 DTM.name: Mercedes-Benz 190E EVO 2 DTM
ams2:Mercedes-Benz 190E EVO 2 DTM.notes: Same car as the AC 190E Evo II DTM. Values copied. ABS yes (AMG ran it from 1992), no TC.

ams2:Chevrolet Corvette GTP.name: Chevrolet Corvette GTP
ams2:Chevrolet Corvette GTP.notes: 1980s IMSA GTP Corvette (the Lola-built car) in the NA 6.0 V8 form the wiki gives: 802 hp, 5-speed dogleg H-pattern (straight-cut dog box, whine 1.0), 1015 kg. A roaring small-block prototype. Nothing electronic (wiki).

ams2:Nissan R89C.name: Nissan R89C
ams2:Nissan R89C.notes: 1989 Group C: VRH35Z 3.5 twin-turbo V8, about 800 hp in race trim, 5-speed straight-cut dog box: two big turbos dumping on lift (1.8), heavy boost shunt. Group C: no ABS, no TC.

ams2:Porsche 962C.name: Porsche 962C
ams2:Porsche 962C.notes: Same car as the AC 962C. Values copied. No ABS, no TC.

ams2:Sauber Mercedes C9.name: Sauber Mercedes C9
ams2:Sauber Mercedes C9.notes: Same car as the AC Sauber C9. Values copied. No ABS, no TC.

ams2:Audi R8 LMP1.name: Audi R8 LMP1
ams2:Audi R8 LMP1.notes: The 2000-05 Audi R8: 3.6 twin-turbo FSI V8 at about 610 hp restricted, Ricardo six-speed sequential paddles (the first pneumatic paddle shift at Le Mans). Turbo dump on lift. LMP1 of 2005 ran TC; no ABS.

ams2:Courage C60 Hybrid.name: Courage C60 Hybrid
ams2:Courage C60 Hybrid.notes: 2005 Courage C60 Hybrid with the Judd 4.0 V10 at 599 hp (wiki), 6-speed sequential paddles, 1004 kg: a screaming NA V10 prototype. Wiki: no TC, no ABS.

ams2:Dallara SP1.name: Dallara SP1
ams2:Dallara SP1.notes: Dallara SP1 with the Judd GV4 4.0 V10 at 599 hp (wiki), 6-speed sequential paddles, 1050 kg. Wiki: no TC, no ABS.

ams2:Lola B05/40 Turbo.name: Lola B05/40 Turbo
ams2:Lola B05/40 Turbo.notes: LMP2 2005 Lola with the AER 2.0 turbo four (about 500 hp): a big turbo four, shaky at idle and violent on lift (1.7). 6-speed sequential paddles. No TC, no ABS (as the V8 sister, wiki).

ams2:Lola B05/40 V8.name: Lola B05/40 V8
ams2:Lola B05/40 V8.notes: LMP2 2005 Lola with the Zytek 3.4 V8 at 548 hp (wiki), 6-speed sequential paddles, 896 kg. Wiki: no TC, no ABS.

ams2:Alpine A424.name: Alpine A424
ams2:Alpine A424.notes: LMDh: Mecachrome 3.4 single-turbo V6 at the 680 hp class cap with the spec Bosch hybrid on the rear axle, Xtrac seven-speed sequential. The hybrid fill tames the lift (1.3). LMDh: TC on, no ABS.

ams2:Aston Martin Valkyrie Hypercar.name: Aston Martin Valkyrie Hypercar
ams2:Aston Martin Valkyrie Hypercar.notes: The only non-hybrid Hypercar: Cosworth 6.5 NA V12 at the class cap, 11000 rpm, Xtrac seven-speed sequential. The V12 scream of an F1 car with no inertia. Hypercar: TC on, no ABS.

ams2:BMW M Hybrid V8.name: BMW M Hybrid V8
ams2:BMW M Hybrid V8.notes: LMDh: P66/3 4.0 twin-turbo cross-plane V8 (from the DTM M4) at the 680 hp cap plus the spec hybrid, Xtrac seven-speed. Turbo V8 rumble, hybrid-tamed lift. TC on, no ABS.

ams2:Cadillac V-Series.R.name: Cadillac V-Series.R
ams2:Cadillac V-Series.R.notes: LMDh: ECR 5.5 NA cross-plane V8 at the cap plus the spec hybrid, Xtrac seven-speed: the loudest, lumpiest engine in the class, a big overrun bark. TC on, no ABS.

ams2:Lamborghini SC63.name: Lamborghini SC63
ams2:Lamborghini SC63.notes: LMDh: 3.8 twin-turbo cold-V V8 at the cap plus the spec hybrid, Xtrac seven-speed. TC on, no ABS.

ams2:Porsche 963.name: Porsche 963
ams2:Porsche 963.notes: LMDh: the 4.6 twin-turbo flat-plane V8 descended from the 918's RS Spyder engine, at the cap plus the spec hybrid, Xtrac seven-speed. Flat-plane buzz with turbos. TC on, no ABS.

ams2:Porsche 911 GT3 Cup 3.8.name: Porsche 911 GT3 Cup 3.8
ams2:Porsche 911 GT3 Cup 3.8.notes: 997 GT3 Cup: 3.8 flat-six at about 450 hp, 8500 rpm, six-speed sequential dog box. Cup cars run without ABS or TC.

ams2:Porsche 911 GT3 Cup 4.0.name: Porsche 911 GT3 Cup 4.0
ams2:Porsche 911 GT3 Cup 4.0.notes: 991/992 GT3 Cup 4.0: 4.0 flat-six at 485 to 510 hp, same six-speed sequential. Same values as the AC GT3 Cup 2017. No ABS, no TC.

ams2:Caterham 620R.name: Caterham 620R
ams2:Caterham 620R.notes: 620R: supercharged 2.0 Duratec at 310 hp in 545 kg with the engine bolted to the tub under your knees: everything comes through, a supercharger bypass sigh on lift (1.2, turbo flag off), six-speed sequential (whine 0.8). No ABS, no TC.

ams2:Caterham Academy 270R.name: Caterham Academy 270R
ams2:Caterham Academy 270R.notes: Academy race Seven: 1.6 Ford Sigma at 135 hp, five-speed H-pattern, live axle, 540 kg. No ABS, no TC.

ams2:Caterham Superlight 360R.name: Caterham Superlight 360R
ams2:Caterham Superlight 360R.notes: Superlight 360R: 2.0 Duratec at 180 hp, 7500 rpm, five-speed H-pattern with a close-ratio set, 560 kg. No ABS, no TC.

ams2:Caterham Supersport 360R.name: Caterham Supersport 360R
ams2:Caterham Supersport 360R.notes: Supersport race 360R: the same 2.0 Duratec and box as the Superlight in the Caterham race series trim. No ABS, no TC.

ams2:Aussie Racing Camaro.name: Aussie Racing Camaro
ams2:Aussie Racing Camaro.notes: Aussie Racing Cars: a 5/8-scale Camaro silhouette on a Yamaha FJR1300 1.3 motorcycle inline-four (wiki, 89 kW), 6-speed sequential bike box, 595 kg: all buzz to 9000 rpm, no inertia, chain-drive shunt. No TC, no ABS (wiki).

ams2:MINI Cooper.name: MINI Cooper
ams2:MINI Cooper.notes: JCW class MINI Cooper (F56 JCW): 2.0 turbo four at 231 hp, six-speed manual, the JCW exhaust pops on the overrun. Road car: ABS and DSC on. Roster name is just MINI Cooper (class JCW); the 1965 Cooper S cars are separate entries.

ams2:BMW M1 Procar.name: BMW M1 Procar
ams2:BMW M1 Procar.notes: 1979 Procar: M88/1 3.5 24-valve inline-six at 470 hp, 9000 rpm, on Kugelfischer injection with a slide throttle (lumpy idle, lope 0.35), straight-cut ZF five-speed dog box (whine 1.0), mid-mounted. 1979: nothing electronic.

ams2:Maserati GranSport Trofeo.name: Maserati GranSport Trofeo
ams2:Maserati GranSport Trofeo.notes: 2005 one-make Trofeo: 4.2 cross-plane V8 at about 420 hp with the Cambiocorsa single-clutch automated manual (hard shifts, shunt 0.7, synchro shape). Trofeo kept ABS and TC.

ams2:Kart 2-Stroke 125cc Direct.name: Kart 2-Stroke 125cc Direct
ams2:Kart 2-Stroke 125cc Direct.notes: Direct-drive 125 cc single-cylinder two-stroke (wiki, 32 hp, 155 kg): one firing every revolution, so layout two-stroke with 1 cylinder; the whole kart buzzes at the firing rate, no inertia, a two-stroke's ragged overrun (pops 0.8, lope 0.4). Direct drive: no clutch, no gears, so the clutch and lug mixes are zero and only the chain-lash shunt plays. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Kart 2-Stroke 125cc Shifter.name: Kart 2-Stroke 125cc Shifter
ams2:Kart 2-Stroke 125cc Shifter.notes: KZ-style 125 cc shifter kart: the same single-cylinder two-stroke at about 45 hp with a 6-speed sequential motorcycle gearbox and a manual clutch (launch judder is real on these), chain-lash shunt. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Kart 4-Stroke Race.name: Kart 4-Stroke Race
ams2:Kart 4-Stroke Race.notes: Four-stroke race kart (Honda GX-class single, about 15 to 20 hp): one firing every two revs, a thumping single with a centrifugal clutch (no clutch or lug effects) and chain lash. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Kart 4-Stroke Rental.name: Kart 4-Stroke Rental
ams2:Kart 4-Stroke Rental.notes: GX390 rental kart: 390 cc four-stroke single at 13 hp with a soft governor-style limiter, centrifugal clutch. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Super Kart 250cc.name: Super Kart 250cc
ams2:Super Kart 250cc.notes: 250 cc twin-cylinder two-stroke superkart, about 90 hp, 13000 rpm, 6-speed sequential: two firings per rev, the most frantic buzz in the game, screaming two-stroke overrun. No TC, no ABS.

ams2:Citroen DS3RX.name: Citroen DS3RX
ams2:Citroen DS3RX.notes: World RX Supercar: 2.0 turbo four at 600 hp with anti-lag, AWD, Sadev six-speed sequential dog box. Anti-lag bangs constantly on the overrun (pops 1.0), the lift is a cannon shot (1.8), heavy shunt through the AWD driveline. No ABS, no TC.

ams2:Mini Countryman R60 RX.name: Mini Countryman R60 RX
ams2:Mini Countryman R60 RX.notes: World RX Countryman: the same 2.0 turbo anti-lag four, AWD and Sadev sequential. RX values. No ABS, no TC.

ams2:Mitsubishi Lancer Evo10 RX.name: Mitsubishi Lancer Evo10 RX
ams2:Mitsubishi Lancer Evo10 RX.notes: World RX Evo X: 2.0 4B11 turbo anti-lag four, AWD, sequential. RX values. No ABS, no TC.

ams2:Volkswagen Polo RX.name: Volkswagen Polo RX
ams2:Volkswagen Polo RX.notes: World RX Polo: 2.0 turbo anti-lag four, AWD, sequential. RX values. No ABS, no TC.

ams2:Super Trophy Truck.name: Super Trophy Truck
ams2:Super Trophy Truck.notes: Trophy truck: 6.8 litre NA V8 at 634 hp (wiki), 3-speed sequential stick, 1400 kg. A big-block lope and heavy pulses, a three-speed with huge driveline lash and long travel driveshafts (shunt 0.9). No TC, no ABS (wiki).

ams2:Lamborghini Veneno Roadster.name: Lamborghini Veneno Roadster
ams2:Lamborghini Veneno Roadster.notes: The Aventador-based Veneno: 6.5 V12 at 750 hp with the ISR single-clutch box that slams its shifts (shunt 0.7). Same values as the AC Aventador SV. Road car: ABS and ESC on.

ams2:Lamborghini Revuelto.name: Lamborghini Revuelto
ams2:Lamborghini Revuelto.notes: 6.5 V12 at 825 hp plus three motors for 1015 hp, 9500 rpm, eight-speed DCT: the V12 scream with electric fill softening the lift. Road car: ABS and ESC on.

ams2:Aston Martin Valkyrie.name: Aston Martin Valkyrie
ams2:Aston Martin Valkyrie.notes: Road Valkyrie: Cosworth 6.5 V12 at 1000 hp and 11100 rpm plus a small hybrid, seven-speed single-clutch sequential (dog-shaped shifts, straight-cut gears audible). An F1-grade V12 in a road car. ABS and TC on.

ams2:Brabham BT62.name: Brabham BT62
ams2:Brabham BT62.notes: Track-only BT62: 5.4 NA quad-cam V8 (Ford Coyote-derived) at 700 hp, 7400 rpm, Holinger six-speed sequential dog box (whine 0.9), race exhaust. Track car with ABS and TC.

ams2:McLaren Senna.name: McLaren Senna
ams2:McLaren Senna.notes: M840TR 4.0 twin-turbo flat-plane V8 at 800 hp, seven-speed DCT, Inconel exhaust that pops. Road car: ABS and TC on.

ams2:Audi R8 V10 GT.name: Audi R8 V10 GT
ams2:Audi R8 V10 GT.notes: 2023 R8 GT: 5.2 V10 at 620 hp, rear-drive, S tronic DCT. Same values as the AC R8 V10 Plus. Road car: ABS and ESC on.

ams2:Chevrolet Corvette C8 Z06.name: Chevrolet Corvette C8 Z06
ams2:Chevrolet Corvette C8 Z06.notes: C8 Z06: LT6 5.5 flat-plane V8 at 670 hp and 8600 rpm, eight-speed DCT: the first screaming road Corvette. Road car: ABS and TC on.

ams2:Dodge Viper ACR.name: Dodge Viper ACR
ams2:Dodge Viper ACR.notes: 8.4 pushrod V10 at 645 hp and only 6200 rpm: the truck-derived ten's odd-fire lope (rock 0.8), heavy pulses at 15 Hz, six-speed Tremec manual with big lash. Road car: ABS and ESC on.

ams2:Maserati GT2 Stradale.name: Maserati GT2 Stradale
ams2:Maserati GT2 Stradale.notes: MC20-based GT2 Stradale: Nettuno 3.0 twin-turbo V6 at 640 hp, eight-speed DCT, turbo flutter on lift. Road car: ABS and TC on.

ams2:McLaren F1 LM.name: McLaren F1 LM
ams2:McLaren F1 LM.notes: F1 LM: the unrestricted GTR engine, BMW S70/2 6.1 V12 at 680 hp, 7800 rpm, six-speed manual H-pattern with the GTR's straight-cut-ish gear set (whine 0.3), open exhaust. 1995 road car: no ABS, no TC.

ams2:Ultima GTR (640).name: Ultima GTR (640)
ams2:Ultima GTR (640).notes: Road Ultima GTR 640: 6.2 LS V8 at 640 hp in a 1000 kg kit car with a Porsche G50 transaxle (five-speed, some whine). Kit car: no ABS, no TC.

ams2:Chevrolet Camaro SS.name: Chevrolet Camaro SS
ams2:Chevrolet Camaro SS.notes: Sixth-generation Camaro SS: LT1 6.2 V8 at 455 hp, six-speed manual. Same values as the AC C7 Stingray (same engine). Road car: ABS and TC on.

ams2:Lamborghini Huracan Super Trofeo EV.name: Lamborghini Huracan Super Trofeo EVO2
ams2:Lamborghini Huracan Super Trofeo EV.notes: Super Trofeo EVO2: 5.2 V10 at 620 hp, X-trac sequential. Same values as the AC Super Trofeo. ABS and TC on.

ams2:Lamborghini Diablo SV-R Super Trofe.name: Lamborghini Diablo SV-R Super Trofeo
ams2:Lamborghini Diablo SV-R Super Trofe.notes: 1996 Diablo SV-R one-make racer: 5.7 V12 at 540 hp, five-speed manual H-pattern with the Countach-style forward gearbox (whine 0.5, lash), open exhaust. Stripped 1990s race car: no ABS, no TC.

ams2:BMW 2002 Turbo.name: BMW 2002 Turbo
ams2:BMW 2002 Turbo.notes: 1973 2002 Turbo: Europe's first turbo production car, 2.0 four with a KKK turbo and no wastegate finesse, 170 hp with a cliff-edge lag (lift-off 1.6, shunt 0.7), four-speed H-pattern. 1973: nothing electronic.

ams2:Chevrolet Corvette C3.name: Chevrolet Corvette C3
ams2:Chevrolet Corvette C3.notes: Road C3 big-block: 427 V8 at about 390 hp on a Holley, 4-speed Muncie: the full muscle-car lope (rock 0.95), heavy pulses at 14 Hz, big flywheel, lots of lash. 1969: nothing electronic.

ams2:Lamborghini Miura SV.name: Lamborghini Miura SV
ams2:Lamborghini Miura SV.notes: Same car as the AC Miura SV. Values copied. Nothing electronic.

ams2:Lotus 23.name: Lotus 23
ams2:Lotus 23.notes: 1962 Lotus 23: Lotus-Ford 1.5 twin-cam four on Webers, about 140 hp, in a 450 kg spaceframe with a Hewland five-speed straight-cut box (whine 0.8). Carburettor idle lope. 1962: nothing electronic.

ams2:MINI Cooper S.name: MINI Cooper S
ams2:MINI Cooper S.notes: Vintage Touring Tier 2 Cooper S: the 1275 A-series on twin SUs, gearbox-in-sump whine (0.5), four-speed H-pattern. Same values as the Copa Classic B 1965 car. Nothing electronic.
